description: List the jobs this account submitted (generate / render_midi / cover / stems / transcribe / session / convert / bounce / the analyses), newest first — to find an earlier result, check what is still running, or resume after a lost connection. Each row names its artifacts (e.g. ["vocals", "drums", "midi_piano"]); doseedo_check_task {job_id} returns the full result with fresh links. Read-only.

before.description: Page cursor: the next_cursor of a previous call.

kind.description: Only this job kind (registry name): generate_music, render_midi, cover_song, separate_stems, transcribe, audio_to_session, convert_project, bounce_session, analyze_song, detect_chords, beat_grid, analyze_midi. Short codes (generate, render, cover, separate, session, convert, bounce, analyze, chords, beats, harmony) are accepted aliases.

session_id.description: Only jobs whose input names this session — a bounce, stems registered into it, a render of one of its tracks (filtered within the fetched page).

name: doseedo_list_jobs
